business_problem: HONOR needed to strengthen the intelligence of its YOYO assistant and device experiences so users could complete richer interaction, productivity, and content-creation tasks without forcing the handset maker to build every model capability alone.
solution_summary: HONOR and Baidu AI Cloud built an end-cloud collaborative assistant architecture around YOYO using Qianfan ModelBuilder, Qianfan AppBuilder, and ERNIE models. HONOR's MagicOS already included device-side AI, but the project added cloud large-model capabilities for PC and mobile assistant workflows such as intelligent creation, meeting-note generation, document question answering, free-form chat, role play, and emotional companionship. The design blends device intelligence with cloud inference so user intent can be recognized more accurately and service responses can be routed across contexts. Long-context ERNIE 3.5-128K models support meeting summarization, task extraction, and templated note generation, while content-generation capabilities enable rewriting, expansion, continuation, and correction across many genres.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud large-model capabilities used to power HONOR's assistant and productivity functions.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Organizes assistant-side application flows for creation, summarization, and document interaction.

solution_components.name: ERNIE 3.5-128K
solution_components.role: Handles long-context meeting understanding, summarization, and task extraction for the assistant experience.

data_flow: User requests from HONOR PC and mobile devices enter YOYO, where device-side AI hands complex tasks to Baidu's cloud models. The platform interprets intent, grounds answers with search or document context when needed, and returns outputs such as meeting summaries, generated content, or multi-document answers back into the assistant UI.
business_outcome: HONOR expanded the intelligence of its assistant, improved intent recognition and conversation quality, automated meeting-note and task-generation work, and opened a path for richer vertical-agent experiences on devices.
architecture_clues: The design is explicitly described as an end-cloud collaborative solution
Long-context ERNIE models are used for meeting-note generation and structured to-do extraction
The assistant is being extended into vertical ecosystems such as education, office work, search, maternal care, health, and commerce
evidence_quotes: HONOR and Baidu AI Cloud used ERNIE large models through end-cloud collaboration to upgrade YOYO for interaction, office productivity, and content creation scenarios (original: 荣耀与百度智能云通过端云协同的文心大模型赋能YOYO助手，实现智能交互、办公提效、内容创作等场景升级).

The solution lets YOYO on both PC and mobile support intelligent creation, meeting notes, multi-document Q&A, free chat, role play, and emotional companionship (original: 基于文心大模型支持YOYO助手PC端和手机端实现智能创作、会议纪要、多文档问答、通用闲聊、角色扮演、情感陪伴等多个智能化能力).

ERNIE 3.5-128K is used for long meeting conversations, intelligent summarization, one-click meeting-note generation, and automatic to-do extraction (original: 文心3.5-128k长上下文模型，高效处理长对话、会议内容智能总结、AI一键生成会议纪要…待办自动生成).
The assistant is also being expanded into vertical ecosystems across education, office, search, maternal care, health, and commerce (original: 智能体生态…在教育、办公、搜索、母婴、健康、商业等垂类展开生态合作).
